utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: Hi, I'd like to renew my passport. What documents do I need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: For a passport renewal you'll need your current passport, one recent passport-style photo, and the completed renewal form. If your name has changed, bring the supporting legal document as well.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: Great. And how long does the renewal usually take to process?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: Standard processing is about four to six weeks. An expedited option is available for an extra fee and typically takes two to three weeks.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: Different question now: can you tell me the opening hours of the downtown office on weekends?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: The downtown office is open Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. and is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: Perfect, thank you for your help.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: I'm trying to set up direct deposit for my paycheck. Where do I start?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: You'll need your bank's routing number and your account number, then complete the direct deposit authorization form from your employer's HR portal. Most employers activate it within one or two pay cycles.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: How do I find my routing number?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: Your routing number is the nine-digit number printed at the bottom-left of a check, or you can find it in your online banking under account details.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: Unrelated follow-up: are there any fees for international wire transfers?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: Yes, international wires typically carry a flat outgoing fee, and the receiving bank may apply its own charge. Currency conversion is done at the daily exchange rate plus a small margin.

utterances.speaker: User
utterances.text: One more thing on a new topic: how do I update the mailing address on my account?

utterances.speaker: Agent
utterances.text: You can update your mailing address in the profile settings of online banking, or by visiting any branch with a photo ID. The change takes effect immediately for statements.
